verdict.rationale: AMD documents the core count (16 cores, up to 32 threads), and independent reviewers corroborate strong application and productivity performance, including a Linux-developer-focused report. Boost behavior is documented only as Precision Boost Overdrive tuning, with no base or boost clock figures. The benchmark evidence gives qualitative summaries rather than concrete multi-core or compile numbers. Missing for 10: documented base/boost clock specifications and boost behavior under all-core load, quantitative independent multi-core and code-compilation benchmark results.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compile big codebases and run heavy parallel jobs fast — documented core counts and boost behavior, corroborated by independent multi-core benchmarks
